# Custom Business Signs Toronto

## Business Identity
- **Name:** Custom Business Signs Toronto
- **Location:** 7250 Keele St, Unit 286, Vaughan, ON L4K 1Z8, Canada
- **Service Area:** Greater Toronto Area (GTA)
- **Founding Year:** 1986

## Core Services
- **Channel Letters:** Vibrant, individual LED-illuminated letters that offer maximum visibility night and day.
- **Storefront Signs:** Complete storefront solutions including fascias, window lettering, and illuminated signs.
- **Vehicle Wraps & Graphics:** Turn your vehicle into a mobile billboard with custom graphics and wraps.
- **Illuminated Signs:** Eye-catching illuminated signage for 24/7 brand visibility.
- **Pylon Signs:** High-visibility freestanding signs designed to grab attention from a distance.
- **Indoor Signs:** Professional interior branding solutions for reception areas, offices, and lobbies.
- **3D Signs & Lettering:** Custom 3D illuminated and non-illuminated signs that provide depth and impact.
- **Window Graphics:** Custom window decals and frostings for privacy and promotions.
- **Construction Signs:** Durable site signage for development, safety, and branding.
- **Digital Signs:** Modern LED displays for dynamic messaging and high-impact advertising.
- **Awning Graphics:** Stylish and functional awnings to enhance your storefront and provide shade.
- **LED Backlit Signs:** High-impact illuminated signs with a sophisticated halo effect.

## Key Differentiators
- **In-House Fabrication:** Design, fabrication (including CNC routing & paint booth), and installation are all handled under one roof to control quality.
- **Turnkey Permitting:** Full-service municipal sign permit navigation across all 10 GTA municipalities.
- **Enterprise Experience:** Trusted by local businesses and national brands like Uber, Telus, and York University.
- **Quality Materials:** Architectural-grade aluminum, 3M and Avery Dennison cast vinyls, and 50,000+ hour rated LEDs.

## Typical Project Pricing (GTA)
- **Channel Letters:** $3,000 to $15,000+ CAD (depends on font, sizing, front-lit vs halo-lit, and mounting).
- **Storefront Fascia & Lightbox Signs:** $2,500 to $12,000+ CAD.
- **Commercial Vehicle Wraps:** $2,500 to $6,500+ CAD (partial decals to full fleet wraps).
- **Pylon & Freestanding Signs:** $10,000 to $35,000+ CAD (including engineering, footing, and crane install).
- **Reception & 3D Lobby Signs:** $1,200 to $5,000+ CAD.
